title: Locating Failure in Multi-Page Visually Rich Document Understanding Systems: An Empirical Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2608.07943v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-page visually rich document understanding (MP-VRDU) systems can fail when evidence is not faithfully represented, not selected, or not used correctly, yet final accuracy alone does not reveal where failures occur. We present an empirical attribution framework that examines these failures through controlled interventions in a unified document question answering pipeline. Experiments on MMLongBench-Doc, with cross-dataset and cross-family checks, show that complementary modalities can reduce sensitivity to conversion errors: images mitigate parser errors, while extracted text reduces dependence on visual resolution. Adding related non-gold pages can both repair incorrect answers and break correct ones, even when all annotated evidence is present, revealing instability beneath aggregate accuracy. Abstention trades unsupported answers for false refusals, while its interaction with reasoning instructions differs across backbones. Qu

translated_title: 定位多页视觉丰富文档理解系统中的失败：一项实证归因研究
translated_abstract: 多页视觉丰富文档理解（MP-VRDU）系统在证据未被忠实表示、未被选择或未被正确使用时可能出现失败，然而仅凭最终准确率无法揭示失败发生在何处。我们提出了一个实证归因框架，通过在统一的文档问答流水线中进行受控干预来检验这些失败。在MMLongBench-Doc上的实验（结合跨数据集和跨模型家族的验证）表明，互补的模态可以降低对转换错误的敏感性：图像可以缓解解析器错误，而提取的文本则降低了对视觉分辨率的依赖。添加相关的非黄金（non-gold）页面既可以修复错误答案，也可能破坏正确答案，即使在所有标注证据均存在的情况下也是如此，这揭示了总体准确率之下的不稳定性。弃权机制以虚假拒绝换取无依据答案的减少，而其与推理指令的交互作用在不同骨干模型之间存在差异。
tldr: 本文提出一个实证归因框架，通过受控干预定位多页视觉丰富文档理解系统在证据表示、选择与使用各环节中的失败来源，发现模态互补可降低转换错误敏感性、非黄金页面会同时修复与破坏答案，从而揭示了总体准确率所掩盖的系统不稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an empirical attribution framework that locates failures in multi-page visually rich document understanding systems through controlled interventions, showing that complementary modalities reduce sensitivity to conversion errors and that non-gold pages can both repair and break answers, revealing instability hidden beneath aggregate accuracy.
